# kits/cascade: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

Cascade: the Iron Republic's hydropowered industrial-agricultural arcology at 568,841 on the Cascade River (Kaskejt Rivr), inspired by Paolo Soleri's Arcvillage I (220 m height, 372 x 372 m / 12.04 ha octagonal massing, ~8,259 refurbished capacity; PLAN.md): arched 32 m Southern Elevated Headrace Aqueduct Viaduct & headgate tower, 3 roaring 32.6 m central waterfall cataracts (WATER.fall + WATER.drawFall), Great Central Industrial Hall (4 spinning overshot hydro-wheels, 4 bevel-gear drive-shaft towers, 5 overhead belt-and-pulley line-shafts, twin riveted penstocks, 4 scroll-case hydro-dynamos with column-tower busbars, 2 reciprocating cam trip-hammers, 2 blast cupola smelting furnaces, overhead ladle crane), 8 carved stepped amphitheater apses, 12 cylindrical column-towers, 5-tier faceted pyramidal crown, tailrace sluice locks, 4 moored cargo barges, and irrigated Twin Circular Gardens (CROPS.forBiome('nhighlands')); 14 planned interior decks across work, civic, living, and rec (1,090 audited rooms, 10,693 catalog pieces, live hatched cross-sections & cutaways, refurbished / intact / ruined states). Verified: build.py, tests/test-cascade.js, verify.py --assert. Read README.md, API.md
